content:
**Anti-Epidemic** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Disease cures can also cure nearby teammates when used.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your disease cures always cure a disease from nearby teammates too. | 00505BCE | 
| ★ | 1 | Your disease cures have a 50% chance to cure a disease on nearby teammates. | 00505BCD |
